projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort (EMS, WSR). R857 is Identified with mitigation assessed but not finalized (EMS 29 June 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may be requested without formal change control.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines may slip, and the team may be unable to absorb additional effort without impacting quality or cost.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change control procedures with impact assessment and client approval before accepting new scope additions.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon approval of scope changes exceeding 0.5 sprint effort, rebaseline delivery plan with Premera and communicate revised timeline to all stakeholders.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R857 carried forward; mitigation assessed but not finalized as of 22 July 2026 (EMS, WSR); no new changes documented in ALT 23 October 2026.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and frequent disconnections are impacting offshore team delivery (EMS, WSR 22 July 2026). A ticket is to be raised with Premera to address the issue (EMS go-green plan). No resolution is documented in ALT (23 October 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Citrix performance issues may persist or worsen.
riskDescription.consequence: Offshore team productivity may continue to decline, extending delivery timelines for future enhancements and increasing the risk of missed commitments.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Citrix performance ticket to Premera IT with SLA and monitor resolution weekly to restore offshore team connectivity.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix issues persist beyond 2 weeks, reallocate critical tasks to onshore resources and adjust sprint capacity planning accordingly.
risks.reasoning: Confirmed by 2 sources (EMS, WSR); no resolution after 3 months (22 July to 23 October); external dependency (Premera IT).

riskDescription.context: No dedicated DevOps resource is planned; DevOps Engineer David (AI Platform Build Claims POD) is providing on-need support (WSR 22 July 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Infrastructure provisioning, deployment automation, or incident response may be delayed when David is unavailable.
riskDescription.consequence: Future releases or production incidents may experience longer resolution times, and infrastructure changes may be deprioritized, impacting delivery velocity.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Cross-train two team members on DevOps tasks and automate deployment pipelines to reduce dependency on David's availability.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When David is unavailable and infrastructure changes are required, escalate to Enterprise Solutions practice lead to allocate backup DevOps resource.
risks.reasoning: On-need support model documented in WSR (22 July 2026); depends on David's availability and competing priorities.

riskDescription.context: Backend code coverage is 57% (WSR 22 July 2026), below the typical 80% threshold for enterprise applications.
riskDescription.condition: Untested code paths may contain defects that are not detected during development or testing.
riskDescription.consequence: Defects may reach production, increasing the post-deployment incident rate and requiring emergency fixes that disrupt planned work.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement mandatory unit test coverage for all new backend code and increase coverage to 75% through sprint-based testing sprints.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If defects reach production due to low coverage, conduct root cause analysis and implement focused regression testing for affected modules.
risks.reasoning: Backend code coverage at 57% per WSR (22 July 2026); no plan documented to improve to standard threshold.

riskDescription.context: 86 CVEs (4 critical, 82 high) are detected on the Alpine base image and are in progress (WSR 22 July 2026). No resolution is documented in ALT (23 October 2026).
riskDescription.condition: One or more critical or high-severity CVEs may be exploited in the production environment.
riskDescription.consequence: A security incident or data breach could occur, triggering regulatory penalties, client escalation, and reputational damage.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Upgrade Alpine base image to latest patched version and validate all 86 CVEs are resolved before end of November.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of CVE exploitation attempt, isolate affected containers immediately and activate incident response protocol with Premera Cyber team.
risks.reasoning: 86 CVEs (4 critical, 82 high) in progress per WSR (22 July 2026); no resolution evidence in ALT (23 October 2026); production deployed.

riskDescription.context: Only one LLM is available in Port Key, which may underperform on specific tasks and prevents the use of a reviewer-agent, leading to manual effort (WSR 22 July 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Agent-generated outputs may contain errors or inconsistencies that are not caught by automated review.
riskDescription.consequence: Manual review effort may increase, and low-quality outputs may reach production, reducing the expected productivity gains from the AAVA framework.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement standardized review checklists for all agent outputs and conduct weekly quality audits to detect errors early.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If agent output quality drops below 90% accuracy, increase manual review frequency to 100% and escalate to AAVA team.
risks.reasoning: Open risk in WSR (22 July 2026); single LLM limitation documented; mitigation includes prompt-engineering workarounds and human review checkpoints.

riskDescription.context: AAVA tool integration with Premera enterprise platforms (SharePoint, Azure Blob, ADO) is not available; atomic agents are used instead (WSR Scope Change #7, 13 April 2026). Refactoring effort will be required when tool integrations become available (WSR Dependency #20, 15 June 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Tool integrations may become available, requiring refactoring of atomic agents to tool-integrated agents.
riskDescription.consequence: Refactoring effort may consume development capacity, delaying future enhancements or requiring additional budget.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define refactoring scope and effort estimate for atomic-to-tool-integrated agent conversion and reserve 1 sprint capacity for future refactoring.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When tool integrations become available, defer non-critical enhancements by 1 sprint to accommodate refactoring effort without impacting commitments.
risks.reasoning: Scope change and open dependency documented in WSR (13 April, 15 June 2026); refactoring effort acknowledged; tool integration availability uncertain.

riskDescription.context: Premera is planning to send registration emails to 2,500+ producers on 22 October 2026 using a big-bang rollout approach (ALT 23 October 2026). End-to-end registration was tested with only 11 users as of 22 October 2026 (ALT). The rollout status is awaited (ALT).
riskDescription.condition: A critical issue may be encountered during the mass producer onboarding.
riskDescription.consequence: The rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated, delaying producer onboarding and damaging Premera's reputation with 2,500+ producers.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct phased rollout with 100 producers first, validate for 48 hours, then expand to remaining producers in batches of 500.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of critical issue affecting more than 5% of producers, halt registration emails immediately, activate rollback procedure, and escalate to Premera program leadership within 2 hours.
risks.reasoning: ALT escalation trigger met (23 October 2026); big-bang approach with limited E2E testing (11 users); confirmed by 2 sources (ALT, WSR decision log).

riskDescription.context: Inadequate agent hardening may cause inconsistent behavior in production (WSR 22 July 2026). A hardening checklist, feedback loop, scenario testing, and fallback logic are planned (WSR mitigation).
riskDescription.condition: Agent hardening may be incomplete or insufficient.
riskDescription.consequence: Agents may produce inconsistent outputs or fail unexpectedly in production, requiring manual intervention and reducing user confidence in the system.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Complete agent hardening checklist with scenario testing for all production agents and implement fallback logic for edge cases by end of November.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If agent produces inconsistent output in production, switch to manual workflow for affected task and log incident for AAVA team review.
risks.reasoning: Open risk in WSR (22 July 2026); hardening mitigation planned but completion status unknown; production deployed by 23 October 2026.

riskDescription.context: Multiple critical and high-impact dependencies are open and externally controlled, including Data Hub (4 total premium fields, Search by NPN), Auth0 (Entra integration), Azure (Front Door & DNS), and Citrix (server performance) (WSR 22 July 2026). Citrix slowness is confirmed in EMS (22 July 2026) and unresolved in ALT (23 October 2026).
riskDescription.condition: One or more external dependencies may be delayed or delivered incomplete.
riskDescription.consequence: Future enhancements or production incident resolution may be delayed, and the team may be unable to meet client commitments without external party cooperation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly dependency review with Data Hub, Auth0, and Premera IT teams to track progress and escalate delays early.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When external dependency is delayed beyond 2 weeks, rebaseline impacted scope with Premera and agree on phased delivery for affected features.
risks.reasoning: Multiple external dependencies documented in WSR (22 July 2026); Citrix unresolved after 3 months (EMS, ALT); confirmed by 2 sources.

riskDescription.context: The team is proceeding with approved UI-based data mappings, but possible values for data are still being discussed (WSR Decision Log #31, 25 June 2026). If issues with values from mappings lead to design changes (entity stitching), timeline impact is possible (WSR 22 July 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Data mapping discrepancies between the Portal, Data Hub, and upstream systems may surface during production use.
riskDescription.consequence: BoB data may be inaccurate, triggering producer complaints and requiring entity stitching changes that delay future releases.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate data mappings with Data Hub and business teams weekly and document approved field values to prevent design rework.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If data discrepancies surface in production, implement data validation layer in Portal wrapper service and communicate corrected mappings to producers.
risks.reasoning: Open risk in WSR (22 July 2026); data mappings approved but values under discussion; design change impact acknowledged.
